question: My order A1004 arrived damaged, I need a refund and I want to speak to a manager now!
answer:
I’m very sorry to hear that your order arrived damaged. Our standard refund policy only covers returns within 30 days of purchase, and since it’s been 60 days, a refund isn’t automatically eligible. 

I’ve escalated your case to a manager so they can review the situation and see what we can do for you. A human support representative will be with you shortly. Thank you for your patience.
